The '''Bivoli system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that shared its name with the [[Bivoli Tempari]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]]<ref name="Riders of the Maelstrom">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> as well as the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Little Bivoli]]''.<ref name="KOTOR13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bivoli system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA" />
